{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue to float to check for QA orders
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Check how many QA orders are in the converted group
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Filter for converted customers with valid age (customer_age != -1) AND exclude QA orders
converted_clean = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1) & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Print results
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA orders with converted == 1:", len(qa_converted))
print("Total converted customers with valid age (excluding QA):")
print(len(converted_clean))
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding QA and age -1): {mean_age}")"}
